newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar falls back after brief NY rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar falls back after brief NY rally.

text.p: White sugar futures saw a brief rally after New York's May contract cleared 11.00 cents/lb but the upside momentum faltered and values slid back into their earlier ranges, traders said on Tuesday.

The foray to an intraday high of 11.01 cents/lb was capped by producer pricing and was not enough to boost activity in London, where the equivalent May whites contract hit $307.30 but then fell back into a range.
Traders said arbitrage activity against the Paris market had provided much of the day's volume after commission house crossed trades earlier in the session.
The London/Paris differentials for May and August were the most active, whereas arbitrage activity against New York was minimal, they said.
"If you're not involved with that, you're not doing much of anything. There's nothing going on," said one.
At 1712 GMT May and August were both up 70 cents at $307.40 and $307.00 respectively. Volume was 1,047 lots.
London's May/August spread was trading at around 20 cents and traders said light interest was also noted in August/October.
The Paris market saw heavier volume on account of the arbitrage activity against London. May was up 70 cents at $307.50 and August up 30 cents at $307.00.
